source.objectiveEnglish: Talk about what you eat and drink for breakfast using present-tense verbs.
source.focusEnglish: Present tense of regular -ar, -er and -ir verbs: yo, tú, usted, nosotros, ellos
source.speakingEnglish: Chat with a fellow guest: say what you eat for breakfast, ask if they drink coffee or tea, and ask if they live here.

archivedDraft.scene: Two guests talk over breakfast in a hotel dining room.

sourceCards.sourceNote: Fried tortilla pieces in red or green salsa; a classic Mexican breakfast.
Fried eggs, usually sunny side up, in Mexico.

sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: サルサ・ベルデ（緑のサルサ）

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Desayuno a las 8 todos los días.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I have breakfast at 8 every day.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 毎日8時に朝ごはんを食べます。

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Do you drink coffee or tea?
sourceCards.sourceNote: Informal tú: use with a fellow guest your age, not with staff.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: コーヒーと紅茶、どちらを飲みますか。

sourceCards.sourceNote: Formal usted: polite with someone you just met.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ここにお住まいですか。
私たちは卵に豆を添えて食べます。

sourceCards.sourceNote: In Mexico, tomar is the usual verb for drinking.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 私の子どもたちは牛乳を飲みます。
日曜日は営業していますか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma desayuna chilaquiles con salsa verde en su hotel.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma has chilaquiles with green salsa for breakfast at her hotel.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマは滞在先のホテルで、朝ごはんにサルサ・ベルデのチラキレスを食べます。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: Desayuno a las 8 todos los días.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: I have breakfast at 8 every day.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：毎日8時に朝ごはんを食べます。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma pone queso y aguacate en sus chilaquiles.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma puts cheese and avocado on her chilaquiles.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマはチラキレスにチーズとアボカドをのせます。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Lucía, otra huésped del hotel, come huevos revueltos con jamón.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Lucía, another hotel guest, eats scrambled eggs with ham.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 同じホテルの別の宿泊客、ルシアはハム入りのスクランブルエッグを食べます。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: ¿Tú tomas café o té?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: Do you drink coffee or tea?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：コーヒーと紅茶、どちらを飲みますか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Lucía
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Lucía: Tomo café, y mis hijos comen avena.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Lucía: I drink coffee, and my kids eat oatmeal.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ルシア：私はコーヒーを飲み、子どもたちはオートミールを食べます。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: ¿Tú vives aquí en Oaxaca?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: Do you live here in Oaxaca?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：ここオアハカに住んでいますか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Lucía
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Lucía: No, vivo en Puebla y allá comemos frijoles.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Lucía: No, I live in Puebla, and there we eat beans.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ルシア：いいえ、プエブラに住んでいます。あちらでは私たちは豆を食べます。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Lucía
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Lucía: En casa, mi esposo come huevos estrellados con tocino.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Lucía: At home, my husband eats fried eggs with bacon.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ルシア：家では、夫は目玉焼きとベーコンを食べます。

source.objectiveEnglish: Ask a server or hotel host the basic questions you need at breakfast.
source.focusEnglish: Question words: qué, quién, dónde, cuándo, cuánto, cómo, por qué, cuál
source.speakingEnglish: Ask a hotel host what breakfast costs, where the restroom is, and what this bread is called.

archivedDraft.scene: Sam checks breakfast details with a hotel café host.

sourceCards.sourceNote: Two words with an accent asks why; porque (one word) means because.
Use cuál to choose from options: ¿Cuál es...?
Mexican sweet rolls, like the shell-shaped concha.

sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: このパンは何という名前ですか。

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: ¿Cuál es el café de la casa?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ハウスコーヒーはどれですか。
このテーブルの担当はどなたですか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator / Emma and Tom
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: En el hotel, Emma y Tom preguntan: ¿Quién nos atiende?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: At the hotel, Emma and Tom ask: Who is serving us?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ホテルで、エマとトムは尋ねます。「このテーブルの担当はどなたですか」

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Rosa
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Rosa: Yo los atiendo, ¿qué café quieren?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Rosa: I am serving you, what coffee do you want?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ローサ：私が担当します。コーヒーは何になさいますか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Tom
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Tom: ¿Cuál es el café de la casa?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Tom: Which is the house coffee?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: トム：ハウスコーヒーはどれですか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Rosa
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Rosa: Es el café de olla, ¿por qué no lo prueban?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Rosa: It is the café de olla, why don't you try it?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ローサ：カフェ・デ・オジャです。試してみませんか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: ¿Cuánto cuesta el desayuno y cuándo termina?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: How much is the breakfast and when does it end?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：朝食はいくらですか。それと、いつ終わりますか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Rosa
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Rosa: Es el desayuno incluido y termina a las 11.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Rosa: It is the included breakfast and it ends at 11.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ローサ：朝食込みで、11時に終わります。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator / Tom
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Tom señala el pan dulce: ¿Cómo se llama este pan?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Tom points at the sweet bread: What is this bread called?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: トムは甘いパンを指さします。「このパンは何という名前ですか。」

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: ¿Dónde está el baño?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: Where is the restroom?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：トイレはどこですか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Rosa
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Rosa: Se llama concha, y el baño está a la derecha.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Rosa: It is called a concha, and the restroom is on the right.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ローサ：それはコンチャというパンです。トイレは右側にあります。

source.objectiveEnglish: Spot Spanish words you already know and use survival phrases when you don't understand.
source.focusEnglish: Cognates ending in -ción, -dad and -ente, plus survival phrases for getting help
source.speakingEnglish: Tell a server you don't understand, ask them to speak more slowly, and ask what the ingredients of the specialty are.

archivedDraft.scene: At a café, Sam cannot understand a seasonal specialty and asks for a slower explanation.

sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ベジタリアン向けの選択肢
すみません、わかりません。

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Can you speak more slowly, please?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: もう少しゆっくり話していただけますか。

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: How do you say this in Spanish?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: これはスペイン語で何と言いますか。
ベジタリアン向けの選択肢はありますか。
助けてください、緊急事態です！

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma tiene una reservación a las 9 en el Café Luna.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma has a reservation at 9 at Café Luna.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマはカフェ・ルナに9時の予約を入れています。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: En la pared hay información de emergencia en inglés y español.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: On the wall there is emergency information in English and Spanish.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 壁には、英語とスペイン語で書かれた緊急時の情報があります。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Rosa
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Rosa: La especialidad de hoy es diferente: chilaquiles con pollo.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Rosa: Today's specialty is different: chilaquiles with chicken.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ローサ：今日のおすすめ料理はいつもと違います。鶏肉入りのチラキレスです。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: Disculpe, no entiendo.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: Excuse me, I don't understand.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：すみません、わかりません。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: ¿Puede hablar más despacio, por favor?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: Can you speak more slowly, please?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：もう少しゆっくり話していただけますか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: ¿Cuáles son los ingredientes?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: What are the ingredients?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：材料は何ですか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Rosa
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Rosa: Los ingredientes son tortillas, salsa verde, pollo y queso.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Rosa: The ingredients are tortillas, green salsa, chicken and cheese.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ローサ：材料はトルティーヤ、サルサ・ベルデ、鶏肉、チーズです。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Emma
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Emma: ¿Hay una opción vegetariana?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Emma: Is there a vegetarian option?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: エマ：ベジタリアン向けの選択肢はありますか。

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Rosa
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Rosa: Sí, la opción vegetariana es excelente y tiene una variedad de verduras.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Rosa: Yes, the vegetarian option is excellent and has a variety of vegetables.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ローサ：はい。ベジタリアン向けの料理はすばらしいですよ。いろいろな種類の野菜が入っています。
